button_title: Send feedback, report a bug or tell us what is missing (Shift+?)
screen_link: Report a problem with this screen
title: Send feedback
intro: We need your help to improve BETA Cutting Room. Tell us what is wrong, confusing or missing. Nothing is sent until you choose how to send it.
kind_legend: What would you like to tell us?
kind_bug_hint: Something is wrong or does not work.
kind_missing_hint: A tool, report or setting you need.
kind_idea_hint: Ideas, praise, or something that was confusing.
details_bug: What happened? What did you expect?
details_missing: What do you need, and why?
details_idea: What would you like to tell us?
contact_hint: Only if you want a reply. On GitHub, everyone can see it.
auto_privacy: No files, patterns, file paths or factory names are added.
numbers: Add anonymous marker numbers (piece count, efficiency, time limit)
error_details: Please describe the problem or idea in a few words.
preview_intro: This is exactly what will be sent. You can go back and change it.
privacy_path: Your text seems to contain a file path. Please remove it if it shows a customer, buyer or factory name.
privacy_file: Your text seems to contain a file name. Please remove it if it shows a customer, buyer or factory name.
privacy_geometry: Your text contains many numbers. Do not paste pattern shapes or coordinates unless you agree to make them public.
send_title: How do you want to send it?
send_github_hint: Needs internet and a free GitHub account. The report will be public.
send_github_desktop_hint: Paste the link into your web browser. Needs a free GitHub account. The report will be public.
send_email_hint: Opens your email app. Only the BETA team will see it.
send_email_desktop_hint: Paste the address into your email app. Then use Copy report for the text.
send_copy_hint: Paste it into an email, chat or message.
send_save_hint: For computers without internet. Send the file later from another computer.
desktop_note: These links open your browser or email app. If opening fails, the link is copied so you can paste it. Nothing is sent automatically.
short_note: The report is long. The link holds a shorter version. The full text is copied to your clipboard, so you can paste it.
done_github: GitHub opened in your browser. Thank you for helping!
done_github_long: GitHub opened. The full report is on your clipboard: paste it into the issue. Thank you!
done_link: Link copied. Paste it into your web browser. Thank you!
done_email: Your email app should open now. Thank you for helping!
done_address: Email address copied. Thank you for helping!
done_copy: Report copied. Paste it where you like. Thank you!
done_save: Report saved. Thank you for helping!
copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text in the preview and copy it by hand.
save_failed: Could not save the file. Use Copy report instead.
welcome_p1: This is a young, open-source project, made by a small team with the help of modern AI tools.
welcome_p2: It is not perfect yet, and we need your help to improve it.
welcome_p3: If something is wrong, confusing or missing, please tell us. Every report helps factories like yours.
welcome_point1: Use the Feedback button at the top of every screen.
welcome_point2: Nothing is sent without your choice. Your patterns and files stay on this computer.
ask_text: Tell us what was hard or missing. It takes one minute.
humble: BETA Cutting Room is young and not perfect yet. We need your help to improve it. Please tell us what is wrong, confusing or missing.
link_copied: Link copied. Paste it into your web browser.
link_opened: Link opened in your default app.
